description: This file defines a React component for displaying and managing user playlists, including features to create, edit, delete playlists, and possibly add/remove songs.

methods.name: Playlists
methods.description: React functional component that manages playlist listing and CRUD operations.

methods.name: fetchPlaylists
methods.description: Fetches all playlists from the backend API and updates state.

methods.name: openDialog
methods.description: Opens dialog for creating or editing a playlist.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Saves the new or edited playlist to the backend API.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Deletes a playlist via the backend API.
